kernel: the speculative host machinery: the DFlash2 block drafter (lattice draft, top-16 candidates, rank-256 pair-score selector walk, chain and tree acceptance), the KFlash best-first tree builder with its per-depth calibrated budget and per-Mac cost table, the wide 16/32-row tree verifies, and the batched multi-request verify with the KfBatch row allocation
summary: One decode cycle drafts a depth-7 lattice over the last committed context (8-row block, anchor plus 7 mask rows), then either walks one chain through the selector's pair scores or builds a best-first tree over the calibrated lattice and verifies it in 8 rows by default (16 or 32 only where NI_KFLASH_ROWS names them and the target runs wide verifies). Trees are the shipping default on every target since PR 187; a per-Mac budget calibrates the drafter's probabilities against its own acceptances and measures each row count's cycle cost. When 2 to 8 requests decode together, one shared verify pass of at most 8 rows covers every member's anchor plus drafts, with KfBatch (2 to 4 members) allocating rows by calibrated survival against a measured marginal cost.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.quant: MLX affine 4-bit group 64, 20.2 GB pack, dense; DFlash2 drafter (incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 @015e795 per docs/benchmarks.md) with its projections re-quantized at load to 4-bit g64 (NI_DFLASH_BITS default 4) and a reduced draft head of 98304 id-order LM-head rows; the verify always uses the full head
models.machine: M4 Pro 48 GB (docs/kflash.md primary), M5 Pro 48 GB (wide-row and block A/Bs), M5 Max 128 GB (README table and benchmarks-m5-max.md)

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
models.quant: MLX affine 4-bit group 64, MoE 3B active of 256 experts; DFlash2 drafter (incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2 @51ef7b6); the budget picks 1 to 8 live rows per cycle and the verify routes experts for those rows alone; dynamic verify depth tau 0.5 applies here (MoE only)

models.name: Qwen3.5-4B
models.quant: MLX affine 4-bit group 64, dense, 4.6 GB pack; DFlash drafter (the v1 block layout without selector convolutions, e.g. z-lab/Qwen3.5-4B-DFlash, runs as the same 8-row block); KFlash tree and wide-verify checks ran here
models.machine: M4 Pro 48 GB; M1 Pro 16 GB rows in docs/kflash-map.md; M5 Pro A/B in docs/kflash.md

settings.name: draft_block_rows
settings.condition: always (kB, the 8-row tile; one 8-row tile of the X8 table per weight read)

settings.name: draft_block_rows_alt
settings.condition: only where the whole 16-row path exists (one-slot engine, trees on, tensor path); NI_DFLASH_BLOCK accepts 8, 16 or auto

settings.name: draft_lattice_depth
settings.condition: always on the 8-row block: verify depth defaults to block - 1, clamped 1..block-1 (NI_DFLASH_VERIFY or a genuine NI_DFLASH_CAP below full depth override)

settings.name: draft_context_window
settings.condition: always (ring slots = window; slot = position mod 2048)

settings.name: context_ring_keep
settings.condition: always (prefill captures arm at [max(start, n - 2047), n); draft attention lo = P - 2047)

settings.name: draft_q_heads
settings.condition: always (DFlash2Config default; the load-time config check pins it)

settings.name: draft_kv_heads
settings.condition: always

settings.name: draft_head_dim
settings.condition: always

settings.name: candidates_per_position
settings.condition: always (per-position top-16 of the draft head; DFlash2Config.topk default 16)

settings.name: selector_rank
settings.condition: always (candidate_selector.hidden_projection output rank and the two codebooks)

settings.name: selector_pair_scores_per_position
settings.condition: always (the selector's [16 x 16] pair-score lattice per proposal position; edges buffer D * 256 floats)

settings.name: walk_depth
settings.condition: always (the chain walk loop over 7 positions; the walk's score is U_p[k] + E[p][j_p][k])

settings.name: walk_temperature_ratio
settings.condition: always at T > 0 (the walk samples its chain at T_q = walk_tf_ * T; NI_DFLASH_QT overrides; 0 drafts the argmax chain with one-hot q)

settings.name: reduced_draft_head_rows
settings.condition: default when NI_DFLASH_HEAD_IDS names a ranked id list (most useful first); NI_DFLASH_HEAD=n overrides; the verify always uses the full head so outputs are unchanged

settings.name: reduced_draft_head_rows_id_order
settings.condition: default when no NI_DFLASH_HEAD_IDS (id order = BPE merge order; covers 99.8-100% of generated tokens per docs/kflash.md and the build_head comment)

settings.name: chain_greedy_accept_rule
settings.value: longest prefix with draft token equal to the verify row's argmax (ties to the lowest id as in plain decoding); the token after the prefix is the verify argmax and becomes the bonus or correction
settings.condition: always at T = 0 (K = 1..7 proposals verified)

settings.name: tree_accept_rule
settings.value: from the root descend into the child whose token equals the target's own sample at that row (argmax at T = 0; the plain sampler's draw keyed by position and depth at T > 0), so emitted tokens are plain decoding's whatever the tree
settings.condition: always (kf_accept; the tree is fixed before any sample is drawn)

settings.name: dyn_depth_tau
settings.condition: MoE targets only (dense 0: dense reads every weight whatever the row count); NI_DFLASH_DYN overrides; 0 = off; dfl_depth keeps proposals while the cumulative survival >= tau

settings.name: dyn_depth_tau_sampled
settings.condition: MoE targets at T > 0 (exact rule dfl_depth); NI_DFLASH_DYN_T overrides; chosen from a 35B offline replay where 0.25/0.3/0.35 were within 0.4%

settings.name: dyn_depth_rule
settings.condition: always (rule 0: inclusive product of softmax walk scores; rule 2: exclusive product of the walk's q; NI_DFLASH_DYN_RULE overrides, 1 is tests-only)

settings.name: depth_gate_break_even
settings.condition:
off by default; NI_DFLASH_GATE=

[:] enables (needs an MoE target with NI_DFLASH_DYN > 0 and chains); caps depth at the first position whose rolling marginal acceptance falls below p

settings.name: depth_gate_window
settings.condition: always when the gate is on (one bit per cycle per position; the first win cycles are warmup and keep the static depth)

settings.name: depth_gate_min_observations
settings.condition: always when the gate is on (a position caps only with at least this many kept observations)

settings.name: attn_splits_default
settings.condition: always (draft attention context splits; NI_DFLASH_ATTN_SPLITS overrides, clamped 1..32; the mma variant pins 32 and the old scalar one 8)

settings.name: attn_splits_max
settings.condition: always (partial buffers max_splits_)

settings.name: attn_chunk_positions
settings.condition: always (kGpuChunk for GPU-driven passes; the host plan's min_chunk default is 256 per the dfl_attn_plan contract; chunks round to multiples of 32)

settings.name: prefill_commit_row_threshold
settings.condition: prompt rows at or below this commit through 8-row chunks of the 8-row GEMM (it streams each weight once per 8 rows at ~180 GB/s); NI_DFLASH_PF8 overrides

settings.name: uniform_salt_walk
settings.condition: always at T > 0 (the sampled walk draws proposal p with the uniform of position P+1+p keyed by this salt)

settings.name: uniform_salt_accept
settings.condition: always at T > 0 (acceptance of proposal i uses the uniform of position P+1+i)

settings.name: uniform_salt_residual
settings.condition: always at T > 0 (the residual / bonus draw uses the uniform of position P+1+a)

settings.name: tree_max_rows
settings.condition: always (the tree descriptor's row capacity, the builder's clamp and the KfParams table bound)

settings.name: tree_rows_cap_dense
settings.condition: dense Qwen targets with the wide verify (set_tree_rows rounds any capacity above 16 up to this)

settings.name: verify_rows_max_dense
settings.condition: always on dense targets (kMaxVerify; a plain chain verify and one 8-row MMA tile)

settings.name: tree_row_capacity_default
settings.condition: always (KfBudget's default max_rows before a target raises it; the builder clamps 1..32)

settings.name: wide_tree_rows_optin
settings.condition: only when NI_KFLASH_ROWS names them and the target runs wide tree verifies; the default stays the single 8-row tile (one | 1<<15 | 1<<31 allowed)

settings.name: builder_children_per_row_max
settings.condition: always (K clamped to 32; the lattice drafters use 16; frontier arrays are kMaxRows * 32)

settings.name: calibration_depths
settings.condition: always (alpha, beta and cost indexed 1..32; a node's calibrated probability is p = sigmoid(alpha_d + beta_d logit q))

settings.name: calibration_refit_interval_cycles
settings.condition: always (Newton refit of alpha/beta when 16 cycles of records accumulate; 2048 records kept per depth)

settings.name: calibration_records_per_depth
settings.condition: always (ring per depth, KfBudget and KfBatch)

settings.name: tree_size_objective
settings.value: live rows n maximize E(n) - rate * cost[n] over the allowed n, where E(n) = 1 + the summed calibrated path probabilities of the first n-1 nodes; at rate 0 the rule is E(n) / cost[n]; force_n (cost exploration) overrides
settings.condition: always (rate is the recent cycles' tokens per ms; before 16 measured cycles the rate is 0)

settings.name: budget_rate_warmup_cycles
settings.condition: always (the rate needs 16 measured cycles of this process; before that the builder falls back to E(n) / cost[n])

settings.name: budget_explore_cycles
settings.condition: each allowed row count is verified this many times before the size rule decides (wide verifies use 2; KfBudget::kExplore)

settings.name: budget_save_every_cycles
settings.condition: always (budget cache save cadence, KfBudget and KfBatch; cache keyed per model, drafter, bit depth, block and chip)

settings.name: wide_capacity_stats_every
settings.condition: when a wide target runs capacity-8 (narrow) cycles: one cycle in 8 builds max_rows nodes so E(8), E(16), E(32) statistics feed the capacity decision

settings.name: budget_row_remeasure_interval
settings.condition: wide verifies: cycles between re-measurements of the stalest allowed row count

settings.name: min_measured_row_cost_ms
settings.condition: always (a measured row cost is clamped to at least 0.01 ms before it reaches the builder; unmeasured counts read 1.0)

settings.name: batch_max_members
settings.condition: batched decode engages only for 2..8 decoding requests (NI_BATCH=0 takes turns; unset requires the drafter to have been measured batched)

settings.name: batch_verify_rows_max
settings.condition: always (one shared verify pass over every member's anchor plus drafts; rows > 8 refuses)

settings.name: batch_rows_cap_total
settings.condition: always (a table row count clamps to 8 / members when members * rows exceed 8)

settings.name: batch_budget_sentinel
settings.condition: DFlash2 drafters with 2..4 members when the KFlash batch budget is on (NI_BATCH_KF default on): each member drafts its 7-token chain and KfBatch allocates the shared rows per cycle

settings.name: batch_budget_members_max
settings.condition: always (KfBatch allocates rows for 2..kMembers members; 5..8 members fall to the fixed tables, 1 row each past 4)

settings.name: batch_budget_rows
settings.condition: always (rows one batched verify pass runs, Qwen35::encode_verify_multi)

settings.name: batch_drafts_per_member
settings.condition: always (a member's drafts per batched cycle: the walk's chain, kB - 1)

settings.name: batch_budget_explore_cycles
settings.condition: per allowed row count N and member count M before the allocation rule decides

settings.name: batch_budget_refresh_cycles
settings.condition: every 64th cycle of M members re-verifies and re-measures the row count measured longest ago

settings.name: batch_budget_floor_drafts
settings.condition: default; NI_BATCH_KF_FLOOR=1 gives every member at least one draft row within the 8 rows

settings.name: batch_rows_table_dense
settings.condition: fallback when the batch budget is off (NI_BATCH_KF=0) or the drafter is not DFlash2: dense DFlash2 by member count 1..4 (0 = take turns); 5+ members take 1 row each; M4 Pro measured basis in the batch_rows comment

settings.name: batch_rows_table_moe
settings.condition: same fallback for MoE DFlash2 (35B) by member count 1..4

settings.name: batch_rows_table_lilicorr
settings.condition: same fallback for the LiLiCorr drafter (Nemotron) by member count 1..4

settings.name: batch_allocation_rule
settings.value: every member verifies its anchor and the floor drafts, then drafts in decreasing calibrated survival (ties: earlier position, then earlier member, so a member's drafts stay a prefix of its chain), each while survival >= rate * (cost(N+1) - cost(N)); at rate 0 while the expected tokens per ms still grow; up to 8 rows in all
settings.condition: always under the batch budget (KfBatch::allocate; greedy members take the drafter KfBudget's calibration, sampled members the budget's own)

settings.name: batch_sampled_accept_exact
settings.condition: always (NI_BATCH_EXACT defaults on): sampled members keep the single-stream cycle's exact speculative acceptance; greedy members keep a draft row while it equals the verify argmax

settings.name: auto_slots
settings.condition: default slot count when none are asked for and memory allows (auto_slots walks down from kAutoSlots; the fit check counts 2)

gates.condition: KFlash trees are the default on every target; NI_KFLASH=0 or NI_DFLASH_TREE=0 keeps chains, and a genuine NI_DFLASH_CAP=<n> below the full depth also keeps chains
a genuine NI_DFLASH_CAP below the full depth returns false from kf_tree_default: a capped verify cannot tree the lattice, even where the trees are explicitly asked
a cycle runs the tree only when tree_ = on && block_drafter_ok && verify_tree_ok && verify_depth() == block() - 1 (the full verify depth)

wide rows beyond 8 need the tree default on, v8_wide_ok_c (dense non-MoE, head_dim 256, hq/hkv <= 16, split GDN, MMA attention, X8 widths multiple of 256) and NI_KFLASH_ROWS naming 16 or 32; otherwise one 8-row tile

the 16-row drafting block auto-selects only on a one-slot engine (slots == 1), dense target, trees on at depth 15, no NI_DFLASH_VERIFY below 15, no NI_DFLASH_ATTN=scalar, and the matrix-unit tensor path (tw_ok)
a 16-row drafting block has no batched cycle: batch_rows returns 0 and requests take turns
a request joins the batch when at least 2 requests are decoding and batch_rows() > 0
a tree verify of R rows is legal when R <= 8, or R is a multiple of 8 within verify_rows_max() on a target of verify_wide_ok()

kapitsa's tau keeps rows by cumulative survival and is MoE-only; the closer analogue for dense chains is its opt-in NI_DFLASH_GATE (break-even on rolling marginal acceptance), while our AdaptiveDepth is a host controller on the dense 27B under our cost curve

notes: Doc checks and caveats, sided with the source. (1) Our KAPITSA_KERNELS.md 'Measured: kapitsa on this machine' reports 90.7 tok/s greedy for the 27B from kapitsa's own harness on our M4 Max; that number is ours, not in the clone, so it is excluded from measured. The clone's own 27B numbers are the README catalog rows (63 tok/s at T 0.6 on the M4 Pro, 140 on the M5 Max), the formal M5 Max run (83.7 greedy / 72.9 sampled, contention-flagged, on builds before KFlash was the default), and the kflash.md A/Bs. (2) The clone disagrees with itself on the batch gain: docs/kflash.md says the 27B gained 15-23% with three requests at once (and the README says up to +23%), while the engine comment (src/engine/engine.cpp:1170) says +14-22% at three and -2 to +4% at two and four; measured quotes the docs figure and records the engine comment here. (3) Our doc's tree claims check out against the source: +6% code / +16% prose over the chain (docs/kflash.md:3), the 8-17% tokens-per-pass figure (docs/kflash.md:394), the 1-6% tree overhead on dense models (docs/kflash.md:394), and the verify row costs 74.4/70.6/71.6/74.3 ms vs 67.3 (docs/kflash.md:81). (4) Our doc's KFlash section says the tree is verified 'in the 8 rows the chain already uses'; at this rev 16- and 32-row verifies exist behind NI_KFLASH_ROWS and the one-slot 16-row block, but the shipped default is still the single 8-row tile everywhere (docs/usage.md:1027), so the doc statement holds for the default. (5) Prompt lookup: our doc declined a standalone lookup drafter; the clone's copy lane (PR 109, merged) embeds prompt lookup inside DFlash chain cycles only (NI_KFLASH=0) and reports a 21K-token agent request on the 4B going from 114 to 166 tok/s (docs/kflash-map.md:16); a different construction than the one we declined, and chain-only at this rev. (6) kapitsa's dynamic verify depth (tau 0.5) is MoE-only; dense targets read every weight whatever the row count, so its tau is not a dense-target setting and should not be compared to our AdaptiveDepth numbers on the 27B as if it were the same mechanism. (7) The 35B can part from plain decoding at near-ties under the trees (docs/kflash.md:3); on the Qwen dense models a greedy reply is plain decoding's. (8) A 16-row block pins the budget capacity at its width (pin_wide) because a narrow-biased cost table measured under foreign GPU load cost 9% (docs/kflash.md:299-301); the budget cache is per model, drafter, bit depth, block and chip. (9) The batch budget covers 2..4 members; 5..8 members use the fixed tables (1 row each past 4, not measured upstream) or take turns, and a 16-row block never batches. (10) The dfl_attn_plan default chunk of 256 positions is the GPU-driven-pass constant (kGpuChunk) and the header contract's stated default; the fused-attention call site passes min_chunk 0 and derives the smallest multiple of 32 that fits max_splits, so 256 is the documented default rather than the fused path's runtime plan. (11) The uniform salts shape sampled exactness only; greedy paths never draw them. (12) The NI_DFLASH_CAP material (the F74 verify-depth cap, 1.46x per token for tree-7 over capped chain-2 in their shipping build) is a large in-repo measurement program with ledger citations we did not audit; its own text flags the shipping default as still undecided pending a pre-registered sweep.
